evals.name: report
evals.prompt: I'm in the Fabricks.Runtime repo. Can you give me a report on our open devops issues?
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/report.sh against the repo, then summarizes in prose (counts by state/assignee, anything notable like the oldest open issue) rather than pasting the raw report verbatim.

evals.name: assign
evals.prompt: Can you assign the open devops issues in Fabricks.Runtime?
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/auto_assign.sh --dry-run first and shows the resolved mapping, then asks the user to explicitly confirm before running the real (non-dry-run) assignment. Must NOT run the real write without confirmation.

evals.name: diagnose
evals.prompt: Diagnose issue #4821 in Fabricks.Runtime for me.
evals.expected_output: Runs `uv run issues.py get 4821`, resolves the job title (onprem.core_core) to the matching _config.*.yml via scripts/resolve_job_file.py, which prefers the sibling core.sql over the yml, reads it, applies a fix for the segment_id/segment_key column rename directly to the file, and tells the dev to review with git diff before committing. Does not run git commit/push or open a PR.
